commits_data.title: tshark: Add option to display machine-readable conversation statistics
commits_data.message:
tshark: Add option to display machine-readable conversation statistics

tshark lost its ability to display raw byte counts for conversations (-z conv) a side-effect of
enhancement #15360 human-readable numbers.

Add a new tshark long option (--machine-readable) that prints raw byte counts for conversations.
Modelled after the ‘capinfos -M’ implementation (note: ‘-M’ option isn’t available for tshark).
Addresses #18321.
